title: Lung Cancer Prevention
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to lung cancer prevention.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports tobacco smoking cessation and LDCT screening for high-risk individuals as primary lung cancer prevention strategies; moderate evidence supports radon mitigation and occupational safety measures; emerging evidence suggests a role for diet and physical activity with ongoing research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
